- The single-file amalgamation (`make amalgamation`, `build/eigenscript_all.c`) compiles without warnings at `-O0` and `-O1` with `-Wall -Wextra`, as it already did at `-O2`. `-O0` reported a missing return at the end of `builtin_tensor_gather`, and `-O1` reported seven possibly uninitialized locals in the bitwise and index paths of the VM; none was reachable, but an embedder building the two-file artifact with warnings on saw them (#1775).
